macros.name: doublespacing
macros.doc: The commands \singlespacing, \onehalfspacing, and \doublespacing, are for use in the preamble to set the overall spacing for the document.

macros.name: onehalfspacing
macros.doc: The commands \singlespacing, \onehalfspacing, and \doublespacing, are for use in the preamble to set the overall spacing for the document.

macros.name: setstretch
macros.doc: If a different spacing is required then the \setstretch{baselinestretch} command can be used in the preamble to set the baselinestretch appropriately.

macros.name: singlespacing
macros.doc: The commands \singlespacing, \onehalfspacing, and \doublespacing, are for use in the preamble to set the overall spacing for the document.

envs.name: doublespace
envs.doc: Three environments, singlespace, onehalfspace, and doublespace, allow the spacing to be changed within the document.
